newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikko Sec, Smith Barney to set up joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Nikko Sec, Smith Barney to set up joint venture.

text.p: Nikko Securities Co said on Friday that it and Smith Barney International Inc of the United States had agreed to set up a joint investment consulting firm in Japan by the end of 1997.
The joint venture will market so-called "wrap" accounts, which are expected to be introduced in Japan as part of the financial sector's ongoing deregulation, a Nikko spokesman said.

The wrap account system, widely used in the United States, allows a securities house to manage an investor's assets based on discretionary management contracts or by introducing third-party advisory firms to investors.
The spokesman said that further details of the tie-up will be announced later on Friday morning.
